About Us

Viridance specializes in mine ecological restoration and environmental governance. We deliver full-lifecycle environmental solutions for mining clients, including EIA compliance consultation, engineering design, ecological construction, on-site environmental management, closure monitoring and environmental equipment supply. We tailor solutions to local site conditions and integrate design, construction, equipment and long-term maintenance. Starting from Zimbabwe, we serve the African market to support responsible mining and sustainable land rehabilitation.

TAB 02

Development History

From our first visit to the Shurugwi cluster in April 2026 to multi-site, multi-discipline service delivery six months later, our growth has been driven by mine operators’ interests, government concerns and surrounding community demands.

April04

Conducted Shurugwi cluster site and farmland surveys (Sites 1, 2, 4, 13) and defined the ecological restoration and demonstration-zone design based on the findings.

May05

Engaged EMA Kwekwe officials on ecological restoration and environmental management and built regulator communication channels to support EIA, EMP and compliance services.

May–Jun05–06

Delivered reclamation works for Shurugwi Sites 1–5, 13 and 16, including design, BoQ and demonstration zones, and established a technical and on-site delivery system.

June06

Partnered with KOODOO on sustainability planning during the first Jena Mine site visit and initiated the sustainability programme alongside Jena Mine EIA preparation.

July07

Launched the “Environmental Housekeeper” service model after surveys across three Chegutu sites and formed the full service chain from survey through rectification and support.

Jul–Aug07–08

Completed the Alpha 12 closure and restoration study covering slope remediation and cost assessment, extending service capacity to full-lifecycle environmental work.

August08

Submitted the mid-term sustainability report and engaged EMA, ZELA and Catchment Councils while building water and legal networks.

Aug–Sep08–09

Progressed ongoing EIA, inspection-support and prospectus work and expanded the integrated EIA, EMP, compliance and long-term management offer.

September09

Hosted Zimbabwean experts for a technical study tour in Guizhou, China, and established research partnerships and green-mining exchange channels.
